title: PR whitespace-only lint check: build the diff from local git against a base revision, not the GitHub .diff URL
answers: The whitespace-check lint step failed with a transient 503 while downloading the PR diff. What changed?
How does the whitespace-only CI check get the pull request diff now?
Where is the PR diff fetched for the whitespace check in lint?
Why does lint.yml pass --base-revision HEAD^1 to the whitespace check?
body:
Path: dev/check_whitespace_only.py:main, the CI lint check that decides whether a pull request changes only whitespace; it takes the --repo, --pr and --base-revision inputs from .github/workflows/lint.yml and gets the diff through get_pr_diff. Bypass-label lookup (get_pr_labels) runs only when whitespace-only changes are detected.
Rule: get_pr_diff runs `git diff --no-ext-diff --no-color <base>...HEAD` on the local checkout instead of downloading github.com/<owner>/<repo>/pull/<n>.diff, which failed with a transient GitHub 503. The base comes from the required --base-revision argument in parse_args; lint.yml passes HEAD^1, which exists because actions/checkout uses fetch-depth: 2.
Symptom: The whitespace-check step in lint failed with an HTTP 503 while fetching the PR .diff from GitHub, although the code under review was fine.
Constraints: Use this pattern when a CI check needs PR diff content and the revision it needs is already in the checkout. The bypass-label lookup still calls the GitHub API and is unchanged. If the checkout depth is reduced below what HEAD^1 needs, the git diff step breaks.
applies: CI and dev tooling that needs the PR diff in MLflow lint workflows, especially dev/check_whitespace_only.py and .github/workflows/lint.yml.
says: Pull request linting fails randomly with server error while downloading the code diff.
The whitespace validation step in continuous integration crashed due to an external network failure.
Inspect pull request changes locally instead of fetching diff files from the web.
Whitespace checker fails if git history is not checked out with sufficient depth.
Allow pull requests with only formatting changes to proceed when special labels exist.
search: In dev/check_whitespace_only.py:main and .github/workflows/lint.yml, the whitespace-only lint check generates the pull request diff using local git diff rather than downloading the GitHub .diff URL. get_pr_diff executes git diff --no-ext-diff --no-color <base>...HEAD using a required --base-revision passed as HEAD^1 from parse_args, enabled by fetch-depth: 2 in actions/checkout. Bypass-label lookup through get_pr_labels still queries the GitHub API when whitespace-only changes occur, but reducing checkout depth breaks the diff command.
